# Pesher Habakkuk Column 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 2 | **Condition:** Moderately well preserved; some lacunae at edges

---

**2:1** "[Look] among-the-nations and-observe, and-be-astonished

**2:2** and-wonder; for a-work is-being-done in-your days

**2:3** that-you-would-not believe even-if

**2:4** it-were-told-to-you" (Hab 1:5).

**2:5** [Its] pesher concerns the-traitors together-with the-Man-of

**2:6** the-Lie, for they-did-not believe the-Teacher-of-Righteousness

**2:7** who-expounded the-Torah correctly. And-it-also-concerns the-traitors-to

**2:8** the-new covenant, for they-were-not faithful to-the-covenant-of God,

**2:9** but-profaned His-holy-name.

**2:10** And-likewise this-word is-to-be-interpreted concerning the-unfaith[ful]

**2:11** at-the-end-of-days. They are the-ruthless-ones [...]

**2:12** who-will-not believe when-they-hear all that-is-to-co[me upon]

**2:13** the-final generation from-the-mouth-of the-priest into-whose [heart]

**2:14** God put [under]standing to-interpret all the-words-of His-servants the-prophets.

**2:15** "For behold, I am-raising-up the-Chaldeans, that-bitter

**2:16** and-hasty nation" (Hab 1:6).

**2:17** Its pesher concerns the-Kittim, who are swift and-mighty in-battle, to-destroy many [...] in-the-dominion-of the-Kittim.

---
*EMET notes: Column 2 covers Hab 1:5-6. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
